on-request.label: On request
on-request.description: Codex can ask for approval when a command needs access outside the sandbox.

untrusted.label: Ask for untrusted commands
untrusted.description: Only commands trusted by Codex can run without approval.

never.label: Never ask
never.description: Prevent requests to expand sandbox access.

default.label: Manual
default.description: Follow Claude Code rules and ask for tool approval when required.

acceptEdits.label: Accept edits
acceptEdits.description: Auto-approve edits and common file operations in allowed directories. Bash and other tools follow Claude Code permission rules.

plan.label: Plan mode
plan.description: Inspect the project and prepare a plan. Wait for approval before executing it.

dontAsk.label: Don't ask
dontAsk.description: Automatically deny tool calls that require approval.

auto.label: Auto approval
auto.description: Claude Code uses a classifier to review tool calls. Actions that explicitly require approval still prompt.

bypassPermissions.label: Full access
bypassPermissions.description: Skip routine tool approvals. Claude Code sandboxing and mandatory safeguards still apply.

edit.label: Auto-edit
edit.description: Keep the editing permissions of this existing conversation.

yolo.label: Full access
yolo.description: Let ZCode take actions without prompting for each one.

default.description: Confirm tool calls as Grok requires them.

auto.description: Grok auto-reviews routine tool calls; calls it cannot clear still ask.

bypassPermissions.description: Skips routine tool approvals. Grok sandbox and enforced protections still apply.

default.description: Confirm tool calls manually as Kimi Code requires them.

auto.description: Kimi Code auto-approves safe operations; other actions still ask.

bypassPermissions.description: Kimi Code auto-approves every tool operation without asking each time.

settings.fullAccessTitle: Enable full access for this {{harness}} conversation?

fullAccessDescriptions.codex: Starting next turn, Codex removes its sandbox and command approvals. File and command access follows your Mac account permissions.
fullAccessDescriptions.claude: Starting next turn, Claude Code skips routine tool approvals. Claude Code still enforces its configured sandbox and mandatory safeguards.
fullAccessDescriptions.zcode: ZCode can change accessible files, run terminal commands, access the network, and call connected tools without asking each time.
fullAccessDescriptions.grok: Starting next turn, Grok skips routine tool approvals. Configured deny rules and enforced protections still run in Grok.
fullAccessDescriptions.dsh: Starting next turn, DSH runs in full access and no longer asks for tool approvals. File and command access follows your Mac account permissions.
fullAccessDescriptions.kimi: Starting next turn, Kimi Code auto-approves every tool operation, including file changes, commands, and connected tools, without asking each time.
